name: Frontend engineer
resumeText: Frontend developer with four years building interfaces in React and TypeScript. Added keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels to a customer portal. Integrated REST APIs and wrote component tests with Vitest.
jobText: Build customer-facing web applications using React and TypeScript. Experience with Next.js and React Testing Library is required. Collaborate with design and API teams.

name: Data analyst
resumeText: Data analyst experienced in SQL and Python for cleaning product and sales datasets. Built Tableau dashboards for weekly reporting and ran A/B test readouts with product managers.
jobText: Analyze warehouse data with SQL and Python. The role requires experience building dbt models and working with Snowflake. Present clear findings to business partners.

name: Backend engineer
resumeText: Backend engineer who built Node.js and Express services backed by PostgreSQL. Added Docker-based local development and API integration tests. Maintained services used by an internal inventory team.
jobText: Develop Node.js services and own PostgreSQL data models. Production experience with AWS and Redis is required. Participate in on-call and improve service reliability.

name: Product designer
resumeText: Product designer using Figma to create flows, prototypes, and production-ready UI specifications. Planned and moderated usability testing for a scheduling product and summarized findings for engineering.
jobText: Design mobile app experiences in Figma and validate concepts with moderated usability testing. Experience establishing and maintaining a shared design system is required.

name: Security analyst

jobText: Monitor and investigate alerts using Splunk or a comparable SIEM, and coordinate incident response. The team also needs AWS security and Terraform experience for cloud controls.
